posts.title: I Built a Portfolio Website That Doubles as Its Own CMS. No Backend Required.
posts.summary: I built a configurable, forkable portfolio platform with Next.js, using GitHub as its CMS and GitHub Actions for deployment. Here's how its architecture, configuration system, migrations, and automation work without a custom backend.

posts.title: Merging Multiple Drives Into a Single Storage Pool With mergerfs
posts.summary: Having multiple external drives connected to a home server is useful, but managing them individually can get a little inconvenient. I wanted to get rid of that inconvenience and have everything accessible through a single directory. Read how I did it.
